entries.title: Psalms 110:1
segments: A Psalm of David. The LORD said to my Lord, Sit at My right hand until I place Your enemies as Your footstool.

entries.title: Psalms 110:2
segments: The LORD shall send the rod of Your strength out of Zion; rule in the midst of Your enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 110:3
segments: Your people [shall be] willing in the day of Your power, in holy adornment from the womb of the morning: You [have] the dew of Your youth.

entries.title: Psalms 110:4
segments: The LORD has sworn, and will not repent, You [are] a priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.

entries.title: Psalms 110:5
segments: The Lord at Your right hand shall strike through kings in the day of His wrath.

entries.title: Psalms 110:6
segments: He shall judge among the nations, He shall fill them with dead bodies; He shall shatter heads over much of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 110:7
segments: He shall drink of the brook in the way; therefore He shall lift up the head.
